references.text: Abidan son of Gideoni is mentioned here first as the leader of the tribe of Benjamin at the census.
Abidan son of Gideoni is named as the leader of the tribe of Benjamin in the camp arrangement.
The following verses describe the actual offering that Abidan presented on the ninth day.
Abidan son of Gideoni led the army of the tribe of Benjamin when the Israelites broke camp from Sinai.
Benjamin was Jacob's youngest son, and his tribe is represented here by Abidan.
